card.fires_on: Small words like the, at, to or near, and partial numbers, right before a Spanish-language place name such as El Chico, El Salvador, Rio Grande or Matamoras. The setting is geography, history or field-study text about the Americas.

modes.description: A preposition or article just before a Spanish or Latin American place name.
